summary: This clipped Snowflake documentation page describes the CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS function, which returns the IP address of the client that submitted the request. It takes no arguments and is shown with a sample query returning 192.0.2.255. Navigation menus, feedback prompts and footer text were ignored.
one_line: Snowflake function CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS, which returns the IP address of the client that submitted the request.
key_facts: CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS returns the IP address of the client that submitted the request.
The syntax of CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS is CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS().
The documentation example runs the query select current_ip_address(); to return the current IP address of the client connected to Snowflake.
In the documented example output, CURRENT_IP_ADDRESS() returns 192.0.2.255.
The function is listed under the Session Object section of the Snowflake documentation navigation.
